title: Sovra Phase 15 Domain Schemas (FTF-1501 -- Tenant isolation suite)
description: Frozen shared domain schemas for the tenant-isolation evidence records (Section 45-47, 52-53, 65-66, 77, 81). Field shapes are copied verbatim from the single real enforcing source, tests/security/tenant_isolation_suite.py's ScenarioResult/TenantIsolationEvidence dataclasses, and tested against it directly in tests/tasks/test_ftf_1501.py so this file cannot silently drift from the code that actually produces these records.

TenantIsolationScenarioResult.description: One real check tests/security/tenant_isolation_suite.py performed -- content-free by construction: only resource kind, check name, method/path and the observed/expected status are recorded, never a request/response body.

TenantIsolationEvidence.description: The immutable evidence output this task's own api_contract names, derived only from real TenantIsolationScenarioResults.
